svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Why Trees Win on Tabular Data
420 points, a staircase ground truth, two model families on identical data
The line finds the trend and stops there. The tree keeps splitting until the steps fit.
Real tabular targets jump at thresholds. That is the shape trees represent natively.
